Theme: Debugging and games

Guest speakers: [Charlie Greene](https://codeberg.org/charliegreene), the Bytes & Bites host and UBVU research software engineer themselves. 

[Register](https://vu-nl.libcal.com/calendar/universitylibrary/Bytes_and_Bites_Mar_2026)

Over the winter in need of a new hobby the educational game [Rogue.Ai](https://codeberg.org/charliegreene/Rogue.Ai) was developed. An open source game focused on helping people to learn how to debug (or speed up their existing skills) Rogue.Ai is a [pandemic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pandemic_(board_game)) inspired game based around the perils of trusting LLMs with too much control of your projects.

Join the session to learn a bit about the creation process, pygame, and a chance to test it out (and provide some feedback if you feel like it)!

Pizza will be served as always!
